facts.fact: Four 把 Al 这场恐惧模拟归类为「失败模拟」：Al 又高又笨拙，坐在自家厨房桌边。
facts.anchor: This simulation is what I call a failure sim.

facts.fact: 模拟里从阴影中走出的女人是 Al 的母亲，指着他责骂。
facts.anchor: And creeping out of the shadows is a woman who I’m pretty sure is his mom, pointing a finger at him and berating him.

facts.fact: Al 哭着对母亲喊「你不会真这么说」，等于当场指出模拟不真实。
facts.anchor: You’d never actually say this! You wouldn’t!

facts.fact: 是 Four 的意志（而非 Al）把两人拉出程序，他是观察者不是参与者。
facts.anchor: It’s my will that pulls us out of the program

facts.fact: Four 解释程序本该压制察觉逻辑矛盾的那部分大脑，并说这叫 dream logic。
facts.anchor: The program is designed to suppress the part of your brain that’s aware of logical incongruities

facts.fact: Four 去年没遇到 Divergent 新生，这套解释他是第一次讲。
facts.anchor: I didn’t encounter any Divergent initiates last year, so I’ve never had to have this conversation before.

facts.fact: 他的直觉是照父亲当年的做法，狠狠警告 Al 不要对任何人说。
facts.anchor: My instinct is to warn him as fiercely as I can against revealing this to anyone, the way my father warned me.

facts.fact: 他给 Al 的办法是下次装作眼前一切都合理，不去想现实会怎样。
facts.anchor: Next time, I want you to pretend that what you’re seeing makes perfect sense to you, no matter what it is.
